title: Meta-learning via Language Model In-context Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's sensitivity to the ordering of in-context examples by decomposing and analyzing the variance of the prediction accuracy with respect to random permutations of the few-shot training examples.

Evaluating and mitigating the model's tendency to copy answers by assigning higher probability to entities that have already appeared in the in-context examples; addressed by pruning the dataset so that object entities appear less than 2.5% of the time.
